title: Strange watch face numbers and no arrow
symptom: On AndroidAPS watch faces, the glucose value appears duplicated, the trend arrow is missing or unreadable, and the date display shows wrong values (e.g., '52' instead of day name, '52 MAY' instead of date). Also, watch face settings crash when scrolling to end, and only the Actions tile works.
cause: The issue was caused by bugs in the AndroidAPS dev build, which were fixed by specific commits. The duplicate numbers and missing arrow were fixed by commit e01647d496e405d3ae9617ae76f353147181ec02, and the IOB display was fixed by commit 7ef313e4aa22acd10571842f1dcfe36400c34fc7. The settings crash was resolved by uninstalling and reinstalling the watch app.
fix: Update to the latest build that includes the fixes (commits e01647d496e405d3ae9617ae76f353147181ec02 and 7ef313e4aa22acd10571842f1dcfe36400c34fc7). For the settings crash, uninstall the watch app and install it again.
evidence_quote: The main screen already shows the trend arrow and the glucose value does not appear twice. TT Tiles are still not working.
